blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable confidence estimation is essential for large language model deployment. However, answer-level calibration remains challenging because generation errors are often localized: a response may be fluent and high-probability overall while still failing at a critical number, entity, or factual claim. Existing estimators compress token probabilities, sequence likelihoods, entropy, or beam statistics into a global score, which can dilute such local risk signals. We propose TRACE , a single-pass, decoded-answer-preserving confidence estimator that treats decoding-time uncertainty as a trajectory through three steps: (i) recording token-level surprisal and predictive entropy during decoding, (ii) applying local risk operators to preserve uncertainty spikes, and (iii) converting localized trace risk into answer-level confidence. TRACE produces a label-free risk score, while TRACE+ calibrates trace-only features into probabilities using a held-out split, without extra generations or external verifiers. We evaluate four tasks against 19 calibration baselines, and TRACE+ reduces Brier from 0.149 0.149 to 0.137 0.137 and improves AUROC from 0.758 0.758 to 0.792 0.792 over the strongest likelihood baseline. Across seven LLMs, TRACE+ improves over the best non-TRACE baseline pool from 0.136 0.136 to 0.120 0.120 Brier and from 0.764 0.764 to 0.817 0.817 AUROC. Results show localizing decoding-time risk provides a general approach to calibration.
blocks.zh: 可靠的信心估计对于大型语文模型的部署至关重要。 然而,答案一级的校准仍然具有挑战性,因为生成错误常常是局部的:反应可能流利和高概率,而关键数目、实体或事实主张仍然失败。 现有的估计器将符号概率,序列概率,py或束统计压缩成一个全球分数,这可以稀释这种局部风险信号. 我们建议TRACE,一个单一的,解码的回答-保留信心估计器,通过三个步骤将解码时间的不确定性作为轨迹处理:(一) 在解码过程中记录象征性的超额和预测的entropy,(二) 应用当地的风险操作员来保持不确定性的尖点,(三) 将局部的微量风险转换成回答层次的信心. TRACE产生无标签风险分数,而TRACE+则使用悬浮分数将仅微量特征校准为概率,没有额外的代数或外部验证器. 我们对照19个校准基线评估四项任务,TRACE+将Brier从0.149 0.149减少到0.137 0.37,并将AUROC从0.758 0.758提高到0.792 0.792,高于最强概率基线。 TRACE+从0.136 0.136到0.120 0.120 Brier和从0.764 0.764到0.817 0.817 AUROC改进了7个LLMs中的最佳非TRACE基线库。 结果显示,将解码时间风险本地化提供了校准的一般方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in generation settings where users need not only an answer, but also a reliable estimate of whether that answer is correct ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Desai and Durrett, 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ) .
This problem is more challenging than standard classification calibration: a generated answer is a sequence of tokens, correctness may depend on a single number, entity, or factual claim, and a fluent response can still be wrong ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Manakul et al., 2023 ; Kuhn et al., 2023 ) . We study general generation calibration : estimating the answer-level correctness probability of a decoded response across diverse generation tasks.
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地部署在用户不仅需要答案,而且需要可靠估计答案是否正确(Guo等人,2017年;Desai and Durret,2020年;Jiang等人,2021年)的生成环境中.
这个问题比标准分类校准更具挑战性:生成的答案是符号的序列,正确性可能取决于单个数字,实体,或事实说法,流利的反应仍然可能是错误的(Kadavath等人,2022年;Manakul等人,2023年;Kuhn等人,2023年). 我们研究一般生成校准 : 估计不同生成任务中解码响应的答案级正确概率.

blocks.en:
A common approach is to compress the decoded answer into a single global confidence score, such as maximum token probability, mean token probability, length-normalized log-probability, total sequence likelihood, or average token
entropy ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Yona et al., 2022 ; Aichberger et al., 2026 ) . Recent single-pass and near-single-pass methods further exploit beam-distribution statistics ( Flores et al., 2025 ) or semantic reweighting ( Duan et al., 2024 ; Bakman et al., 2024 ) . While effective in many cases, these methods largely summarize a generation as a sequence-level statistic. This can erase an important part of the decoding process: where uncertainty occurs.
A response may appear confident on average while becoming locally unstable at the critical step where a wrong digit, entity, or factual attribution is produced.
blocks.zh:
一种常见的方法是将解码后的答案压缩成一个单一的全球信任分数,如最大符号概率,平均符号概率,长度正常的对数概率,总序列概率,或平均符号等.
(Guo等人,2017年;Yona等人,2022年;Aichberger等人,2026年). 最近的单行道和近单行道方法进一步利用光束分布统计(Flores等人,2025年)或语义重置(Duan等人,2024年;Bakman等人,2024年)。 虽然这些方法在许多情况下是有效的,但在很大程度上总结了一代人作为序列级统计。 这可以抹去解码过程的一个重要部分:即发生不确定性的地方.
平均而言,答复似乎具有信心,但在产生一个错误的数字、实体或事实归属的关键阶段,当地变得不稳定。

blocks.en: Multi-sample uncertainty estimators address generation uncertainty from another direction by comparing multiple sampled outputs or semantic equivalence classes ( Manakul et al., 2023 ; Kuhn et al., 2023 ) . However, these methods require additional generations and may change the inference workflow, which can be costly when confidence estimates are needed for every answer. We therefore focus on a stricter and more deployment-oriented setting: single-pass, decoded-answer-preserving confidence estimation . In this setting, all methods score the same decoded answer and do not use extra samples, retrieval, external verifiers, or LLM-as-a-judge labels at actual inference time.
blocks.zh: 多样本不确定性估计器通过比较多样本产出或语义等同类来解决另一方向的生成不确定性(Manakul等人,2023年;Kuhn等人,2023年)。 然而,这些方法需要更多的代代相传,并可能改变推论工作流程,当每个答案都需要信心估计时,推论工作流程可能代价高昂. 因此,我们侧重于更严格和更面向部署的环境:单一通道、解码回答和保留信心估计。 在此设定中,所有方法都得分相同的解码答案,不使用额外的样本,检索,外部验证器,或实际推断时间的LLM-as-a-judge标签.

blocks.en: Our key observation is that decoding-time uncertainty should be treated as a token-level trajectory rather than immediately collapsed into a global score. Local entropy, surprisal, and risk peaks can appear near the critical answer span in real errors, such as a wrong number in arithmetic reasoning, a wrong entity in open-domain QA, or an unsupported factual claim in truthfulness-sensitive generation. These local peaks are not direct labels of token-level error, but they are informative indicators of answer-level risk. Figure 1 provides an overview of the empirical gains from this trace-based design across tasks and model families.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要看法是,解码时间的不确定性应当被当作象征性的轨迹,而不是立即崩溃成全球分数。 在真实错误中,局部的entropy,suprisal,和风险峰值可以出现在临界解答跨度附近,如算术推理中的数字错误,开放域QA中的实体错误,或者在真实感敏感的一代中不支持的事实主张. 这些本地峰不是象征级错误的直接标签,而是解答级风险的信息性指标. 图1概述了在任务和模范家庭之间从这种微量设计中获得的经验成果。

blocks.en: Based on this observation, we propose TRACE , a single-pass confidence estimator based on decoding-trace risk localization . Given a fixed decoded answer, TRACE records token-level surprisal and predictive entropy during the original generation pass, but instead of immediately averaging them, it applies local risk operators that preserve position-sensitive uncertainty spikes. We further introduce TRACE+, which maps trace-only features to calibrated probabilities using a lightweight calibrator trained on a held-out calibration split. Thus, TRACE is label-free, while TRACE+ uses supervised post-hoc calibration requiring only decoding-trace features at inference.
blocks.zh: 基于这个观察,我们提议TRACE, 一个基于解码-追踪风险本地化的单通道信任估计器。 鉴于一个固定的解码答案,TRACE在最初的一代传球中记录了象征级的超导和预测型 en,但是它并没有立即平均,而是应用了当地的风险操作器来保存对位置敏感的不确定性突起. 我们进一步采用了TRACE+,它使用一个在悬停校准分法上受过训练的轻量级计算器,对微量概率进行校准。 因此,TRACE是无标签的,而TRACE+则使用有监督的加热后校准,在推论中只需要解码-跟踪特征.

blocks.en: We evaluate TRACE and TRACE+ on multilingual QA, arithmetic reasoning, open-domain QA, and truthfulness-sensitive generation. Across four tasks, 19 confidence estimators, and seven LLMs, TRACE+ achieves the best average Brier score and AUROC, transfers across model families and scales, and remains strong without conventional selected-token likelihood summaries. Our contributions are:

blocks.en: • We formalize and evaluate generation calibration under a single-pass protocol, where all methods score the same generated answer without extra samples, retrieval, or external verifiers. • We propose TRACE and TRACE+, which estimate answer-level confidence from localized surprisal and entropy patterns in the decoding trace, rather than relying on global sequential summaries that dilute critical uncertainty spikes. • We evaluate across four tasks, 19 confidence-estimating baselines, and seven LLMs, showing that TRACE+ achieves the best average Brier score and AUROC across diverse models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Confidence estimation is commonly framed as calibration, where predicted confidence should match empirical correctness ( Platt, 1999 ; Niculescu-Mizil and Caruana, 2005 ; Naeini et al., 2015 ; Guo et al., 2017 ; Kuleshov et al., 2018 ) . In NLP, language models and QA systems are often miscalibrated, especially under distribution shift or when probabilities are used directly as confidence ( Desai and Durrett, 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ) . Generation confidence estimators therefore derive answer-level scores from decoding statistics, including maximum softmax probability ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017 ; Guo et al., 2017 ) , mean/minimum token probability, length-normalized log-probability, sequence likelihood, and entropy ( Yona et al., 2022 ; Malinin and Gales, 2021 ; Aichberger et al., 2026 ) . Recent methods further use first-token confidence ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , entropy dynamics ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , uncertainty patterns over generated sequences ( Manakul et al., 2023 ) , and beam-distribution statistics ( Flores et al., 2025 ) . These estimators are efficient, but many compress decoding into a global sequence-level score; TRACE instead preserves localized surprisal and entropy patterns along the decoding trajectory.
blocks.zh: 信心估计通常被设定为校准,预测信心应当与经验正确性相符(Platt,1999年;Niculescu-Mizil和Caruana,2005年;Naeini等人,2015年;Guo等人,2017年;Kuleshov等人,2018年)。 在NLP中,语言模型和QA系统常被错误校准,特别是在分配转移中或概率直接用作置信时(Desai and Durrett, 2020;Jiang等人, 2021;Kadavath等人, 2022). 因此,生成信心估计器从解码统计中得出答案级分数,包括最大软max概率(Hendrycks和Gimpel, 2017年;Guo等人, 2017年),平均/最小符号概率,长度正常的对数概率,序列概率,以及py(Yona等人, 2022年;Malinin和Gales, 2021年;Aichberger等人, 2026年). 近代方法进一步使用先触后置置信(Chen等人,2026年), en动力学(Zhu等人,2026年),生成序列的不确定性规律(Manakul等人,2023年),以及束分布统计(Flores等人,2025年). 这些估计器是高效的,但许多人压缩解码为全球序列级分数;TRACE反而沿解码轨迹保留了本地化的超导和 en图案.

blocks.en: Another line of work estimates uncertainty through self-evaluation or semantic comparison. Self-consistency and sampling-based methods use agreement across completions as reliability evidence ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Manakul et al., 2023 ) , while semantic entropy measures uncertainty over meaning-level equivalence classes ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ) . Related work also studies verbalized confidence, self-evaluation, and whether models can assess the truth of their own answers ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2022a ; Tian et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) . These methods can reveal uncertainty beyond a single decoded answer, but require extra samples or inference procedures. TRACE instead targets a decoded-answer-preserving setting without extra sampling, retrieval, external verifiers, or LLM-as-a-judge labels. It is also related to TokenSAR and MARS, which reweight tokens or sentences by semantic relevance or meaning contribution ( Duan et al., 2024 ; Bakman et al., 2024 ) ; however, TRACE asks where decoding-time risk becomes locally concentrated rather than which generated components are semantically important.
blocks.zh: 另一类工作通过自我评价或语义比较估算不确定性。 自我一致性和基于抽样的方法将跨完成的约定作为可靠性证据(Wang等人,2023年;Manakul等人,2023年),而语义式的entropy测量意义水平等同类的不确定性(Kuhn等人,2023年)。 相关工作还研究了口头化的信心、自我评价以及模型是否能够评估自己答案的真实性(Kadavath等人,2022年;Lin等人,2022年a; Tian等人,2023年;Xiong等人,2024年). 这些方法可以揭示出超出单一解码答案的不确定性,但需要额外的样本或推论程序. 反之,TRACE的目标是一个解码的回答保留设置,没有额外的采样,检索,外部验证器,或LLM-as-a-judged 标签. 这也与TokenSAR和MARS有关,它们通过语义相关性或意为贡献来重新加权符号或句子(Duan等人,2024年;Bakman等人,2024年);然而,TRACE询问解码时间风险在哪里变得集中在当地,而不是哪些生成的组件具有高度重要性.

blocks.en: 3.2 Method Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 方法概览

blocks.en:
Figure 2 summarizes the TRACE pipeline.
Given a prompt and a fixed decoded answer, TRACE proceeds in four steps. (i) LLM generation. The model generates an answer under the original decoding policy; TRACE keeps this answer fixed. (ii) Decoding trace construction. During the same pass, TRACE records selected-token surprisal and predictive entropy at each decoding step. (iii) Local risk extraction. TRACE applies early/global, position-decayed, local-peak, and shape/length operators to preserve localized uncertainty. (iv) Confidence estimation. TRACE produces a label-free monotone confidence score, while TRACE+ calibrates trace-derived features into answer-level probabilities using a held-out split.

blocks.en: 3.3 Decoding Traces as Local Risk Signals
blocks.zh: 3.3 将追踪解码为局部风险信号

blocks.en:
Global confidence estimators such as mean token probability, mean entropy, or sequence likelihood collapse a generated answer into a single scalar. While this captures overall uncertainty, it discards where uncertainty occurs during
decoding. This location information is often decisive: an answer can appear fluent overall yet fail at a final digit, an entity name, or one unsupported factual claim.

解码. 这种位置信息往往具有决定性意义:一个答案总的来说似乎很流利,但在最后数字、实体名称或一个无根据的事实索赔中却失败。

Figure 3 motivates preserving local decoding structure: within bins of similar average risk, stronger local spikes correspond to higher empirical error rates, and low-average but high-spike examples are
underestimated by average-based scores. These diagnostic results show that local instability provides risk information beyond global summaries alone (Appendix A ). We therefore model decoding-time
uncertainty as an ordered trajectory rather than collapsing it into a sequence-level statistic.

blocks.zh: 3.5 TRACE+:经过校准的追踪信心

blocks.en: TRACE+ learns how to map trace-derived risk patterns to calibrated probabilities. For each decoded answer, we construct a trace-only feature vector ϕ ⁡ ( τ ) \boldsymbol{\phi}(\tau) from the same decoding trace, including early and global entropy confidence, answer length, entropy slope, and position-decayed entropy and surprisal confidence. We intentionally exclude conventional selected-token likelihood summaries, such as minimum token probability, geometric mean token probability, and low-probability token rate; these are included only in the “+ seq. likelihood” ablation. We train a lightweight logistic calibrator on a held-out calibration split: c TRACE+ ​ ( x , y ^ ) = σ ⁡ ( b + 𝐰 ⊤ ​ Std ​ ( ϕ ⁡ ( τ ) ) ) , c_{\textsc{TRACE+}}(x,\hat{y})=\sigma\!\left(b+\mathbf{w}^{\top}\mathrm{Std}(\boldsymbol{\phi}(\tau))\right), where Std ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathrm{Std}(\cdot) standardizes each feature using calibration-split statistics. The calibrator is not an answer verifier, does not inspect the answer semantically, and does not use alternative generations. TRACE and TRACE+ require no additional decoding passes and use only token-level probabilities and entropies from the original generation.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate general generation calibration on MLQA ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) , SVAMP ( Patel et al., 2021 ) , TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) , and TruthfulQA ( Lin et al., 2022b ) , covering multilingual QA, arithmetic reasoning, open-domain QA, and truthfulness-sensitive generation. We use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024b ) for the main comparison and seven additional LLMs for generalizability and cross-model evaluation: Llama-3.1-8B/70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , Phi-3.5-MoE-Instruct ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) , Qwen2-57B-A14B ( Yang et al., 2024a ) , Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Gemma-2-9B ( Team et al., 2024 ) . We report Brier score ( Brier, 1950 ) , ECE ( Naeini et al., 2015 ) , and AUROC ( Fawcett, 2006 ) ; Brier and ECE evaluate probability calibration, while AUROC measures confidence ranking and selective-prediction risk on shared decoded outputs across generation settings.

blocks.en: We compare TRACE with 19 baselines from five families: (i) token/sequence likelihood scores, including First-Token Prob ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , MeanProb, length-normalized LogP, SeqLogP / Total NLL, MinProb, and high-probability token rate ( Chrabaszcz et al., 2026 ; Aichberger et al., 2026 ; Bakman et al., 2024 ) ; (ii) entropy/position scores, including mean/max entropy, first- k k entropy ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and last- k k entropy ( Li et al., 2026 ) ; (iii) trajectory diagnostics, including windowed entropy ( Sriramanan et al., 2024 ) , entropy variance/slope ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and token-probability slope ( Shapiro et al., 2026 ) ; (iv) near-single-pass beam scores, including Beam-Ratio, Beam-TailThinness, and Beam Entropy ( Flores et al., 2025 ) ; and (v) semantic reweighting scores, including TokenSAR ( Duan et al., 2024 ) and MARS ( Bakman et al., 2024 ) . All methods score the same decoded answer; beam methods only add beam statistics from the same prompt. AUROC uses raw ranking scores, Brier uses held-out calibrated probabilities, and results are averaged over 20 random calibration/evaluation splits. blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares TRACE+ with likelihood-, entropy-, trajectory-, beam-, and semantic-reweighting confidence estimators on four generation tasks. We make two observations. (i) TRACE+ achieves the best average calibration and discrimination performance, obtaining the lowest average Brier score and the highest average AUROC among all methods. Compared with the strongest non-TRACE method on the average columns, SeqLogP / Total NLL, TRACE+ reduces average Brier from 0.149 0.149 to 0.137 0.137 and improves average AUROC from 0.758 0.758 to 0.792 0.792 . TRACE+ also attains the best Brier score on all four tasks and the best AUROC on TriviaQA; on MLQA and TruthfulQA, its AUROC is second-best, while on SVAMP it trails beam-distribution methods in AUROC but still gives the lowest Brier score. (ii) Strong baselines are task-dependent: SeqLogP / Total NLL performs best on MLQA, beam-distribution statistics are strongest on SVAMP, and semantic reweighting helps on TruthfulQA, but none is consistently best across tasks. TruthfulQA is highly imbalanced ( 86 / 817 86/817 correct), for which a constant base-rate predictor obtains a Brier score of 0.0942 0.0942 ; hence Brier differences are compressed despite larger AUROC differences.
TRACE+ is more stable because it aggregates localized decoding-trace evidence under the same decoded-answer setting, yielding consistently stronger average performance overall without changing the model outputs.

表1将TRACE+与可能性-, en-,轨迹-,束-,以及语义重置对四个生成任务的信心估计器进行比较. 我们提出两点意见。 (一) TRACE+实现最佳平均校准和歧视表现,在所有方法中获得最低平均Brier分数和最高平均AUROC. 与平均列上最强的非TRACE方法SeqLogP / Total NLL相比,TRACE+将平均布里尔从0.149 0.149降至0.137 0.37,并将平均AUROC从0.758 0.758降至0.792 0.792. TRACE+还在所有四项任务上都取得了最佳的Brier分数,在TriviaQA上获得了最佳的AUROC分数;在MLQA和TreatfulQA上,其AUROC分数第二,而在SVAMP上则追踪了AUROC中的光束分配方法,但仍然给出了最低的Brier分数. (二) 稳健的基线取决于任务:SeqLogP / Total NLL在MLQA上表现最好,光束分配统计在SVAMP上表现最强,语义重新加权有助于TrealfulQA,但是在任务中没有一个是一贯最好的. TruthfulQA高度失衡(86 / 817 86/817正确),为此,恒定基率预测器获得布赖尔比分0.0942 0.0942. 尽管AUROC存在较大的差异,布里尔差异还是被压缩.
TRACE+更稳定,因为它将本地解码跟踪证据汇总在同一解码解答设置下,在不改变模型输出的情况下,总体平均性能持续增强.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 examines whether TRACE captures risk that is lost by global aggregation.
We select real incorrect generations from the main evaluation set whose decoding traces contain localized high-risk regions, and compute two scores on the same traces: mean aggregation, which averages token-level risk over the whole answer, and TRACE local-peak risk, which preserves the largest localized risk region. As shown in Figure 5 (a), many incorrect answers contain sparse risk peaks rather than uniformly high uncertainty. Figure 5 (b) shows that mean aggregation often assigns these examples modest answer-level risk because the peak is diluted by many low-risk tokens, whereas TRACE local-peak risk remains high.
This supports our central hypothesis that answer-level failures can be locally concentrated in the decoding trajectory, and that preserving local risk structure provides information beyond global likelihood or entropy summaries.
blocks.zh:
图5审查了TRACE是否掌握了全球汇总损失的风险。
我们从主要评价中选择真正的不正确的世代,他们的解码痕迹包含局部高风险区域,并在同样的痕迹上计算两个分数:平均汇总(平均整个答案为象征性水平风险)和TRACE本地峰值风险(保留最大局部风险区域)。 如图5(a)所示,许多不正确的答案包含少量的风险峰值,而不是统一的高度不确定性。 图5(b)显示,平均汇总往往指定这些例子,因为峰值被许多低风险标志稀释,而TRACE本地峰值风险仍然很高。
这支持了我们的中心假设,即解码轨迹可以局部集中解答级故障,而维护局部风险结构提供的信息超出了全球概率或 en总结.

blocks.en: We further evaluate whether TRACE is particularly effective on localized errors, where correctness depends on a compact semantic span. We distinguish these from globally diffuse failures and match each error slice with correct answers by task and answer length. TRACE+ improves localized-error AUROC from 0.778 0.778 for the strongest non-TRACE baseline to 0.805 0.805 , while TRACE reaches 0.796 0.796 . Across number/arithmetic, entity/span, and factual-claim errors, TRACE+ obtains AUROC of 0.927 0.927 , 0.836 0.836 , and 0.607 0.607 , respectively. These results show that localized decoding-trace uncertainty is informative when correctness hinges on a compact critical span. Detailed results are provided in Appendix E.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估TRACE在局部误差上是否特别有效,正确性取决于紧凑的语义跨度. 我们把这些与全球扩散的失败区分开来,并按任务和回答长度将每个错误片段与正确的答案相匹配。 TRACE+改进了本地化-EROR AUROC,从最强的非TRACE基线的0.778 0.778提高到0.805 0.805,而TRACE则达到0.796 0.796. TRACE+在数字/算术、实体/span和事实索赔错误方面分别获得0.927 0.927、0.836 0.836和0.607 0.607的AUROC。 这些结果表明,当正确性取决于紧凑的关键时期时,局部的解码追踪不确定性就具有信息性。 详细结果见附录E.3。

blocks.en: We next examine the contribution of the three risk operators in the TRACE score. Using position-decayed entropy D D , local-window entropy M M , or length-normalized surprisal L L alone gives average AUROC of 0.751 0.751 , 0.754 0.754 , and 0.758 0.758 , respectively, while their fixed combination improves to 0.772 0.772 . A learned combination of the three operators reaches 0.776 0.776 , indicating that the fixed TRACE formulation captures most of the benefit without task-specific fitting. Controlled perturbations show that disrupting risk positions reduces ranking quality, supporting position-sensitive local aggregation. Performance remains stable across broad variations of α \alpha , β \beta , γ \gamma , λ \lambda , w w , and ρ \rho . Full results are provided in Appendix E.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查三个风险操作者在TRACE分数中的贡献。 使用位置减值的 enD,本地-窗口pyMM,或长度正常的LL单表示平均AUROC分别为0.751 0.751,0.754 0.754,0.758 0.758,而它们的固定组合则改善为0.772 0.772. 三个操作者的学习组合达到0.776 0.776 ,表明固定TRACE配方能捕捉到大部分的惠益,而不需要特定的任务。 受控扰动显示,破坏风险位置会降低排名质量,支持对位置敏感的本地汇总. 性能在α-α、β-β、γ-γ、λ-lambda、w、和ρ-rho等广泛差异中保持稳定。 附录E.4提供了全部结果。

blocks.en:
We further examine whether TRACE+ gains arise only from calibrating the fixed TRACE score or from richer trace features. As shown in Table 3 , calibrating the TRACE scalar improves Brier from 0.182 0.182 to 0.154 0.154 while leaving AUROC unchanged at 0.772 0.772 . Learning the three core operators further improves to 0.140 0.140 Brier and 0.778 0.778 AUROC, while the full TRACE+ reaches 0.137 0.137 and 0.792 0.792 .
Thus, TRACE+ improves ranking as well as probability calibration, showing that its gains extend beyond scalar post-hoc calibration.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步审查TRACE+的收益是否仅来自固定TRACE分数的校准,还是来自较丰富的微量特征。 如表3所示,将TRACE scalar校准使Brier从0.182 0.182改进为0.154 0.154,而AUROC不变为0.772 0.772。 学习三个核心操作器进一步提升到0.140 0.140 Brier和0.778 0.778 AUROC,而完整的TRACE+则达到0.137 0.37和0.792 0.792.
因此,TRACE+改进了排名和概率校准,表明其增益超越了标准度后校准.

blocks.en: Table 4 evaluates TRACE+ feature variants in the main four-task and seven-model cross-model settings. Our final TRACE+ uses only trace-derived features, excluding conventional selected-token likelihood summaries. Adding minimum token probability, geometric mean token probability, and low-probability token rate slightly hurts performance, reducing main-setting AUROC from 0.792 0.792 to 0.787 0.787 and cross-model AUROC from 0.817 0.817 to 0.816 0.816 . Feature-removal results further show that the trace signals are complementary. Entropy-only and likelihood-only variants are consistently weaker than TRACE+, while removing trajectory slope gives a marginal main-setting Brier gain but reduces cross-model AUROC from 0.817 0.817 to 0.808 0.808 . We therefore retain the full trace-only feature set for stronger overall cross-model robustness.
blocks.zh: 表4评价了TRACE+在主要四任务和七模式交叉模式设置中的特征变体. 我们最终的TRACE+只使用微量衍生特征,不包括常规的选取概率摘要. 加上最小的代号概率,几何平均代号概率,低概率代号率略微伤害性能,使主设定的AUROC从0.792 0.792降至0.787 0.787,跨型的AUROC从0.817 0.817降至0.816 0.816. 特性清除结果进一步表明,微量信号是互补的。 仅限Entropy和只限概率的变体始终比TRACE+弱,而去除轨迹坡度则给予边际主定Brier增益,但将跨型AUROC从0.817 0.817减少到0.808 0.808. 因此,我们保留了加强整体跨模型稳健性的完全跟踪特征。

blocks.en:
We further test whether localized trace risk is complementary to semantic reweighting.
As shown in Table 5 , adding TRACE components improves MARS ( Bakman et al., 2024 ) from 0.173 / 0.754 0.173/0.754 to 0.141 / 0.775 0.141/0.775 Brier/AUROC and TokenSAR ( Duan et al., 2024 ) from 0.174 / 0.738 0.174/0.738 to 0.141 / 0.781 0.141/0.781 .
Conversely, adding MARS to TRACE+ slightly worsens both metrics, while TokenSAR raises AUROC only marginally from 0.7920 0.7920 to 0.7959 0.7959 without improving Brier.
Thus, localized trace risk strengthens semantic estimators, whereas semantic scores add little additional information beyond TRACE+.

因此,本地化的微量风险会加强语义估计器,而语义分数除了TRACE+之外,不会增加多少额外信息.

blocks.en: Figure 6 (a) evaluates how TRACE+ scales with the size of the held-out calibration split on MLQA, SVAMP, TriviaQA, and TruthfulQA. With only 5 % 5\% calibration data, TRACE+ already matches the strongest baseline in Brier score, although its AUROC is less stable. As the calibration split increases, TRACE+ improves consistently: from 20 % 20\% onward, it achieves both the lowest Brier score and the highest AUROC among all compared estimators. At the default 35 % 35\% split, TRACE+ obtains 0.137 0.137 Brier and 0.792 0.792 AUROC, outperforming SeqLogP / Total NLL at 0.148 0.148 Brier and 0.762 0.762 AUROC. This suggests that TRACE+ benefits from a modest calibration set, but does not require a large labeled split.
blocks.zh: 图6(a) 评估TRACE+在MLQA、SVAMP、TriviaQA和TrealfulQA上如何划分持有量校准的大小。 TRACE+只有5%的5QQ校准数据,已经匹配了布里尔分数中最强的基线,尽管其AUROC不太稳定. 随着校准分数的增加,TRACE+不断改进:从20%的20++到20%,它既取得了Brier分数最低的成绩,也实现了AUROC在所有比较估计数中的最高成绩。 在默认的35%35QQ拆分时,TRACE+得到0.137 0.37 Brier和0.792 0.792 AUROC,在0.148 0148 Brier和0.762 0.762 AUROC中表现优于SeqLogP / 总NLL. 这表明TRACE+从适量的校准集中受益,但并不需要大额的标签拆分.

blocks.en: Figure 6 (b) provides a complementary view of how the calibrated confidence scores behave. In the reliability diagram, TRACE+ stays close to the diagonal across confidence bins, indicating that its predicted confidence better matches empirical accuracy. The risk-coverage curve evaluates selective prediction by retaining the most confident answers at each coverage level under a rejection setting. TRACE+ yields lower risk over most coverage levels, showing that its confidence scores are useful not only as calibrated probabilities, but also for ranking which answers should be trusted in downstream use.
blocks.zh: 图6(b)提供了对校准后信心分数如何表现的补充看法。 在可靠性图中,TRACE+与横跨置信箱的对角保持接近,表明其预测的置信度更符合经验准确性. 风险覆盖曲线通过在拒绝设定下保留每个覆盖级别最有信心的答案来评价选择性预测. TRACE+在大多数覆盖水平上的风险较低,表明其信心分数不仅对校准概率有用,而且对下游使用时应信任的答案的排名有用。

blocks.en: Figure 6 (c) tests whether TRACE+ mainly exploits answer-length effects. We split examples into short, medium, and long groups according to generated answer length and evaluate all methods under the same calibration protocol. TRACE+ maintains the lowest Brier score across all three groups and achieves the strongest AUROC in each group across length strata. The advantage remains clear for long answers, where sequence-likelihood scores are more sensitive to accumulated token probabilities. This indicates that TRACE+ is not simply learning a length proxy, but captures localized decoding-risk evidence that remains useful across lengths. Detailed results corresponding to Figure 6 are provided for completeness in Appendix E.5 .
blocks.zh: 图6(c)测试TRACE+是否主要利用解答长度效应. 我们根据生成的答题长度将实例分为短、中、长组,并根据同一校准协议评估所有方法。 TRACE+保持所有三个组的最低Brier得分,并在每个组的长度层中实现最强的AUROC. 对于长的答案来说,优势仍然很明显,在长的答案中,序列相似分数对累积的符号概率比较敏感. 这表明TRACE+不仅仅是在学习长度的代用,而是捕捉局部的解码风险证据,这些证据在长度上仍然有用. 附录E.5提供了与图6对应的详细结果,说明其完整性。

blocks.en: We further evaluate a stricter transfer setting where the calibrator is trained on three source tasks and directly evaluated on a held-out target task without target-task calibration labels. As shown in Table 6 , TRACE+ preserves competitive correctness ranking: it slightly improves AUROC on MLQA ( 0.814 0.814 vs. 0.813 0.813 ) and TruthfulQA ( 0.659 0.659 vs. 0.644 0.644 ), while remaining close on SVAMP ( 0.842 0.842 vs. 0.843 0.843 ) and TriviaQA ( 0.832 0.832 vs. 0.835 0.835 ). However, Brier score degrades on tasks with substantially different correctness priors, especially MLQA ( 0.347 0.347 vs. 0.264 0.264 ) and TruthfulQA ( 0.212 0.212 vs. 0.137 0.137 ). This indicates that decoding-trace features transfer better as ranking signals than as fully calibrated probabilities, and supports our use of a small held-out target calibration split for TRACE+ in the main protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价更严格的转移设置,即对校准员进行三个源任务的培训,并直接评价一个没有目标任务校准标签的被搁置目标任务。 如表6所示,TRACE+保持了竞争性的正确性排名:它在MLQA(0.814 0.814 vs.0.813 0.813)和TrealFulQA(0.659 0.659 vs.0.644 0.644)上略有改进,同时在SVAMP(0.842 0.842 vs.0.843 0.843)和TriviaQA(0.832 0.832 vs.0.835 0.835)上保持接近. 然而,布赖尔得分却在前作有显著不同正确性的任务上退化,特别是MLQA(0.347 0.347 vs.0.264 0.264 )和TrealfulQA(0.212 0.212 vs.0.137 0.37 ). 这表明解码跟踪特性作为排名信号的传输优于完全校准概率,并支持我们在主要协议中为TRACE+使用一个小的悬浮目标校准分.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we study general generation calibration and propose TRACE , a single-pass confidence estimator that models decoding-time uncertainty as a structured token-level trajectory. TRACE combines position-sensitive, local-peak, and length-normalized local risk operators to produce a label-free confidence score. TRACE+ learns richer trace features with a lightweight held-out calibrator to produce calibrated correctness probabilities. Across 19 baselines and eight LLMs, TRACE consistently improves correctness ranking over standard likelihood and entropy estimators, while TRACE+ further improves calibration and ranking, achieving the best overall Brier score and AUROC. Ablations show gains arise from localized decoding-trace evidence and remain robust across models, answer lengths, and calibration sizes.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们研究一般生成校准,并提议TRACE, 一种单通道置信估计器,将解码时间不确定性作为结构化的符号级轨迹。 TRACE结合了位置敏感,局部峰值,长度正常的局部风险操作员,生成无标签信心分数. TRACE+用轻量级的悬浮计算器学习更丰富的痕量特征,以产生校准的正确性概率. TRACE在19个基线和8个LLMs中,不断提高正确性,高于标准概率和演算器,TRACE+则进一步提高校准和排名,实现最佳的总体Brier分数和AUROC. 解码显示,本地化的解码跟踪证据产生收益,并且在各模型、答案长度和校准尺寸之间保持坚固。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: TRACE requires token-level probabilities or entropy during decoding, which may be unavailable from closed-source APIs. Since TRACE estimates confidence from a single decoded answer, it complements retrieval, multi-sample consistency, and external verification for factual errors with little decoding-time instability. TRACE+ further requires a representative held-out calibration split.
blocks.zh: TRACE在解码时需要符位概率或 en,闭源API可能无法提供. 由于TRACE从一个单一解码的答案中估算出信心,它补充了检索,多样一致性,以及对事实错误的外部核查,很少解码时间不稳定. TRACE+还需要有代表性的悬浮校准分解.

blocks.en:
This section summarizes the features used by TRACE and TRACE+.
For each decoded answer, we record the selected-token probability and the predictive entropy at each decoding step.
These values form two token-level traces: selected-token surprisal and token entropy.
TRACE estimates answer-level risk from the structure of this decoding trace, with emphasis on where uncertainty appears rather than only how large the average uncertainty is.
blocks.zh:
本节概述了TRACE和TRACE+所使用的特性.
对于每个解码的答案,我们记录在每个解码步骤上所选择的切入概率和预测的 en.
这些值形成两个符号级的痕迹:被选中的托肯顶部和符号 en.
TRACE从这种解码痕量的结构中估算出答案层次的风险,重点是不确定性出现的地方,而不仅仅是平均不确定性有多大.

blocks.en:
TRACE combines three fixed risk signals.
First, it uses a position-decayed entropy score, which gives more weight to uncertainty at earlier decoding steps.
Second, it uses the maximum entropy over a short local window, which preserves localized uncertainty spikes.
Third, it uses a length-normalized total surprisal term, which retains selected-token likelihood information without applying the full penalty of unnormalized sequence likelihood.
In all experiments, TRACE uses the same fixed configuration:
blocks.zh:
TRACE结合了三个固定的风险信号.
首先,它使用位置递减的 en分数,在较早的解码步骤中给予不确定性更多的分量.
第二,它通过一个短的局部窗口使用最大 en,这保存了局部的不确定性尖峰.
第三,它使用长度常态化的总超额术语,它保留了选取的托肯概率信息,而不应用非常态化序列概率的全罚.
在所有实验中,TRACE使用相同的固定配置:

blocks.en: Appendix C Protocol comparison

blocks.en:
This section summarizes the inference assumptions of representative confidence estimators.
Table 10 compares whether each method scores the original decoded answer, can be computed from a single generation pass, requires additional generations, uses a semantic modeling component, or learns a held-out calibrator.
Likelihood- and entropy-based scores are inexpensive and single-pass, but they typically collapse the decoding trace into global statistics.
Beam-based scores still preserve the evaluated answer, but require additional beam statistics from the same prompt.
Sampling-based methods such as SelfCheckGPT and Semantic Entropy can capture uncertainty beyond a single decoded answer, but require extra generations and may no longer score exactly the same answer under the same inference workflow.
TRACE is designed for the stricter single-pass, decoded-answer-preserving setting, while TRACE+ adds only a lightweight held-out calibrator for calibrated probabilities.
blocks.zh:
本节概述代表性信心估计者的推断假设。
表10比较了每种方法是否对原始解码答案进行分数,是否可以从一个一代的通过中计算,是否需要额外的代数,使用语义模型元件,或者学习一个被搁置的计算器.
假象-和 en基的分数成本低廉,而且单次通过,但它们通常会把解码的微量分解成全球统计数据。
基于Beam的分数仍然保留着被评价的答案,但需要从同一提示得到额外的光束统计.
SelfCheckGPT和Semantic Entropy等基于取样的方法可以捕捉到超出单一解码答案的不确定性,但需要额外的代数,并且可能不再在同一推论工作流程下得到完全相同的答案.
TRACE是为更严格的单传,解码的答录保留设置而设计的,而TRACE+只为校准概率添加一个轻量级的悬浮计算器.

blocks.en: We further analyze whether decoding-trace localization is particularly useful for errors whose correctness depends on a compact semantic span. We divide incorrect generations into two groups. Localized errors are failures determined by a compact part of the answer, including number/arithmetic errors, incorrect entities or spans, and unsupported factual claims. Global errors include off-topic, incoherent, abstaining, or multi-span failures. For each error slice, we compare against correct answers matched by task and answer length.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析解码跟踪本地化对于正确性取决于紧凑语义跨度的错误是否特别有用. 我们把不正确的世代分成两组。 本地化错误是指由答案的紧凑部分确定的失败,包括数字/算术错误,不正确的实体或跨度,以及无根据的事实索赔. 全球错误包括非专题、不一致、弃权或多频段故障。 对于每个错误切片,我们比较与任务和答案长度匹配的正确答案.

blocks.en: Table 14 reports discrimination performance for localized and global errors. TRACE and TRACE+ improve localized-error AUROC from 0.778 0.778 for the strongest non-TRACE baseline to 0.796 0.796 and 0.805 0.805 , respectively. The advantage also holds at low-FPR operating points: TRACE performs best at 5 % 5\% FPR, while TRACE+ achieves the highest TPR at 10 % 10\% and 20 % 20\% FPR and the strongest partial AUROC below 10 % 10\% FPR. For global errors, the fixed TRACE score achieves the highest AUROC among the compared methods. These results suggest that preserving localized decoding uncertainty is particularly useful for compact-span failures, while the fixed TRACE aggregation also remains effective for more diffuse generation errors.
blocks.zh: 表14报告了地方性和全球性错误的歧视表现。 TRACE和TRACE+分别将本地化-EROR AUROC从最强的非TRACE基线的0.778 0.778提高到0.796 0.796和0.805 0.805。 这一优势在低FPR操作点也具有:TRACE的性能最好,为5% 5 QQ FPR,而TRACE+的性能最高,为10% 10 Q和20% 20 QQ FPR,最强的部分AUROC低于10% 10 QFPR. 对于全局错误,固定TRACE得分在比较方法中达到AUROC最高. 这些结果表明,保留局部的解码不确定性对压缩-散热故障特别有用,而固定TRACE汇总对于更分散的生成错误仍然有效。

blocks.en: We decompose the localized set into number/arithmetic, entity/span, and factual-claim errors. As shown in Table 18 , TRACE+ achieves the strongest AUROC on all three subtypes, reaching 0.927 0.927 , 0.836 0.836 , and 0.607 0.607 , respectively. Compared with the strongest non-TRACE baseline for each subtype, these correspond to gains of 0.048 0.048 , 0.035 0.035 , and 0.018 0.018 . The improvement is largest for number/arithmetic and entity/span errors, where correctness often turns on a short critical token span. The trend persists for factual-claim errors despite a smaller subset.
blocks.zh: 我们把本地化的集分为数字/数字、实体/span和事实索赔错误。 如表18所示,TRACE+在所有三种亚型上都实现了最强的AUROC,分别达到0.927 0.927,0.836 0.836,0.607 0.607. 与每个子类型的最强非TRACE基线相比,这些基准对应于0.048 0.048、0.035 0.035和0.018 0.018的增益。 数字/算术和实体/span误差的改进幅度最大,准确性往往在短的关键值间隙。 尽管有较小的子集,但事实索赔错误的趋势仍然存在。

blocks.en: E.4 TRACE Operator Analysis
blocks.zh: E.4 TRACE操作员分析

blocks.en: This section provides additional analysis of the three operators used in the fixed TRACE score: position-decayed entropy D D , local-window entropy M M , and length-normalized surprisal L L . We examine their individual contributions, the importance of preserving positional structure, and robustness to the fixed hyperparameter configuration.
blocks.zh: 本节对固定TRACE分数中使用的三个运算符进行补充分析:位置减速的 enD,局部窗口的 enMM,长度正常的 surLL. 我们审查了他们个人的贡献、保留位置结构的重要性以及对固定超参数配置的稳健性。

blocks.en: Table 15 compares each operator individually with their fixed and learned combinations. The three individual operators obtain similar but complementary discrimination performance, with average AUROC ranging from 0.751 0.751 to 0.758 0.758 . Combining them in TRACE improves AUROC to 0.772 0.772 , while a learned combination of the same operator outputs reaches 0.776 0.776 . Thus, the fixed TRACE aggregation captures most of the benefit of combining the three risk signals without task-specific fitting.
blocks.zh: 表15将每个操作员与固定和学习的组合进行单独比较。 3个个体经营者获得类似但互补的歧视表现,平均AUROC从0.751 0.751到0.758 0.758不等. 在TRACE中将它们组合起来,使AUROC提高到0.772 0.772,而同一操作器输出的学习组合则达到0.776 0.776。 因此,固定的TRACE汇总捕捉到将三种风险信号组合起来而无特定任务配置的大部分好处.

blocks.en: Table 15: Operator-level analysis of TRACE components and their fusion.
blocks.zh: 表15:TRACE组件及其聚变的操作员级分析.

blocks.en: We further test whether TRACE benefits from where risk occurs along the decoding trajectory rather than only from the overall distribution of token-level risk. We perturb the positions of the risk signals while preserving their values and recompute the TRACE ranking score. As shown in Table 17 , this perturbation consistently reduces AUROC across all four tasks, lowering the average from 0.772 0.772 to 0.755 0.755 . The result indicates that the ordering and location of uncertainty provide useful information beyond the marginal magnitude of token-level risk.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步检验TRACE是否受益于在解码轨迹上发生的风险,而不是仅仅受益于象征性风险的总体分布。 我们扰动风险信号的位置,同时保留其价值,并重新计算TRACE的排名分数. 如表17所示,这种扰动使AUROC在所有四项任务中持续减少,平均从0.772 0.772降至0.755 0.755。 结果显示,不确定性的顺序和位置提供了超出象征性风险的边缘程度的有用信息。

blocks.en: We evaluate the robustness of TRACE to its fixed hyperparameters by varying one parameter at a time. When varying one mixture weight, the other two weights are renormalized according to their original ratio. As shown in Table 16 , performance remains stable across broad parameter ranges. Across all tested settings, Brier varies from 0.152 0.152 to 0.160 0.160 and AUROC from 0.763 0.763 to 0.775 0.775 , indicating that TRACE does not rely on a narrow hyperparameter configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一次不同参数评估TRACE对固定超参数的稳健性。 当一个混合物重量不同时,另外两个重量会根据其原始比例重新正常化. 如表16所示,各大参数范围内的业绩保持稳定。 在所有测试的设置中,Brier从0.152 0.152到0.160 0.160不等,AUROC从0.763 0.763到0.775 0.775 0.775不等,表明TRACE不依赖于狭义的超参数配置.

blocks.zh: 表16:超参数灵敏度分析。

blocks.en: E.5 Robustness and Reliability Analyses
blocks.zh: E.5 强性和可靠性分析

blocks.en: This section provides the tabular data underlying Figure 6 . We test whether TRACE+ remains stable under three conditions: calibration-set size, calibrated confidence and selective prediction, and answer length. Results are averaged over MLQA, SVAMP, TriviaQA, and TruthfulQA using the main evaluation split protocol. Table 19 reports performance as the calibration split increases from 5 % 5\% to 50 % 50\% , testing whether TRACE+ requires a labeled calibration set. Table 20 reports ECE, Brier, AUROC, and selective-prediction risk at coverage levels, evaluating confidence reliability and its usefulness for deciding which answers to trust. For Table 20 , metrics here are computed after pooling predictions across tasks within each split. Table 21 reports performance on short, medium, and long answers, testing whether TRACE+ remains effective across generation lengths.
blocks.zh: 本节提供图表6的表格数据。 我们测试TRACE+在三个条件下是否保持稳定:校准-设定大小,校准置信度和选择性预测,以及答题长度. 利用主要评价分协议,在MLQA、SVAMP、TriviaQA和TrealfulQA中平均得出结果。 表19汇报了校准分解的性能,从5% 5\%提高到50% 50\%,测试TRACE+是否需要标注的校准集. 表20报告欧洲经委会、Brier、AUROC和有选择的预测风险的覆盖范围,评价信任的可靠性及其对决定何种信任的答案的有用性。 就表20而言,此处的衡量尺度是在对每一拆分内的任务进行预测之后计算的。 表21报告了短、中、长的答复情况,测试TRACE+是否仍然有效跨代长度。

blocks.en: Table 19: Calibration-size robustness in Brier/AUROC.
blocks.zh: 表19:Brier/AUROC校准尺寸坚固度。

blocks.en: Table 20: Reliability and selective-prediction results.
blocks.zh: 表20:可靠性和选择性预测结果。

blocks.en: Table 21: Length-stratified robustness in Brier/AUROC.
blocks.zh: 表21:Brier/AUROC的长度稳定。

blocks.en: These results show that TRACE+ is robust across evaluated calibration sizes, produces reliable confidence scores after calibration, and remains effective across answer-length strata. They also provide the values corresponding to the curves in Figure 6 , facilitating robustness and reliability analyses.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,TRACE+在经过评价的校准尺寸上是强劲的,在校准后产生可靠的置信分数,并且在整个答题周期上依然有效. 这些数据还提供了与图6中的曲线对应的数值,便于进行稳健性和可靠性分析。
